guidance.chooseWhen: Pick a date, time, date-time or range.
features: Draft selection with Apply/Cancel, Clear, quick options, month/year Selects and nested time fields.
constraints: Fields default to outlined/neutral. Trigger appearance stays on the trigger; internal month/year/time fields are always outlined/neutral. Tone accents selections and selected quick tags; actions retain their own hierarchy.
Calendar/range and wheel selection states keep their own state styling. Values are Date/time objects, not arbitrary strings.
setup: PortalProvider with a stable PortalStore and a mounted PortalsHost; configure Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets.

guidance.valueContract: Stage a draft in the flyout; Apply commits, Cancel discards. Clear edits the draft.
guidance.inheritance: Variant styles the trigger only. Flyout surfaces stay neutral; month/year and time fields always use outlined/neutral; tone accents calendar/wheel selections and selected soft quick-option tags. Nested time fields are outlined/neutral and retain the selection accent in their own flyouts. Apply is filled/primary; Cancel is outlined/primary; Clear uses primary text.
